name: Switch
summary: A single setting that takes effect immediately — on or off.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-switch> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the track fills brand when checked and the knob slides. Emits a composed `change` CustomEvent<{checked}>. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

opinion.note: Never mix switches and checkboxes in one group. The label names what the setting controls as a noun phrase; the switch communicates the action — don't prefix the label with Enable/Turn on. Reach for `loading` on an async setting that may fail, `size=small` in a dense list, and checked/unchecked children only when the on/off meaning isn't obvious from context.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Switch component-set + AntD matrix: size (default | small), disabled, loading (spinner in the knob), and checkedChildren/unCheckedChildren (text or icon inside the track). The default-size look is matched to the measured DS V3 `toggle` cell: track 44×22, radius pill, 1px #D4D4D4 border, off #F7F7F7 (gray-20), on #6A1EBB, disabled 40% opacity (small = 28×16 knob-12, from the AntD scale). All bound to canonical gray/primary/text-tertiary tokens; the knob slide + track fill + spinner animate on persistent nodes via the shared motion tokens (checked/loading toggle a host attr, never a rebuild — the Switch-click trap).

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Asserts the checked default track (brand fill + 44px) AND a size-dependent width via the size=small sibling in the preview (28px).
